text_block_list.text:
One day in the plaza, I spot Эйр Грув
sitting
with her shoulders slumped
dejectedly. I approach
her, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This doesn't concern you. Don't stick
your nose
where it doesn't belong.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I didn't pay enough attention to some of
my
flowers, so they withered away.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I allowed myself to
become this
lax. What's gotten into me?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув's mood doesn't improve for a
while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
